blocks.text: GENEVA — Parts of a man’s body were found in the Rhine river near Switzerland’s border with Germany, police said, adding investigators suspect he may have been the victim of a violent crime. The remains were found on Sunday after three men walking along the riverbank in the town of Stein, near Basel, spotted a bag floating in the water.
